snapshot.name: Packrift Item Fitment Agent Gateway

endpoints.description: Fetch item fitment gateway counts and source boundaries.
endpoints.response_description: Public JSON stats for source-backed item types, fit records, product-family rollups, product-type rollups, dimension bands, slack bands, and source asset URLs.

endpoints.description: Fetch sample public Packrift item-fitment rows.
endpoints.response_description: Public-safe sample rows with source item dimensions, candidate Packrift SKU, product URL, family, product type, volume ratio, slack band, and atlas evidence URL.

endpoints.description: Fetch source item rollups for the fitment gateway.
endpoints.response_description: Public source item records with source labels, fit record counts, tight candidate counts, and gateway item URLs.

endpoints.description: Enumerate Item Fitment Gateway crawlable URLs.
endpoints.response_description: XML sitemap containing gateway home, manifest, OpenAPI, data, methodology, and source item URLs.

snapshot.agent_notes: Read-only public gateway. No account, login, API key, private credential, payment, or 2FA is required. Pricing for this reference corpus is free. Candidate fit evidence only; measure the packed item, cushioning, closure, and live product page before purchase. This is not a fit guarantee, product-substitution approval, live checkout, shipping quote, delivery promise, certification, vendor financial disclosure, margin report, customer/order/cart/payment system, private source path, private freight source, or live availability claim.
snapshot.description: A compact no-auth Packrift gateway for source-backed item-fitment evidence and public-safe packaging dimension candidates.
